author: Insta360
description:
How far can you push a 53g pocket camera? In this creator spotlight, FPV filmmaker @man.fromearth takes Insta360 GO Ultra on a real-world field test in the tropics: drone flights through tight gaps, knife-mounted POV shots, crash tests, and camera angles nothing bigger could reach.

Rather than a traditional camera review, this video pushes GO Ultra's mounting options and image quality to their limit in hot, humid, fast-moving conditions.

In this video:
- POV mounts, compared: the Magnet Pendant, the Easy Clip and a mouth mount for the full 156° first-person view.
- FPV drone integration: an ultra-light setup with ND filters, flown through gaps a normal rig can't fit.
- 4K 60fps and durability: a bigger 1/1.28" sensor, put through drops, drone crashes and a car run-over.
- New hardware: microSD storage up to 2TB, 10m waterproofing and Apple Find My via the Action Pod.
- Creative camera angles: paddleboards, kitchen knives and PureVideo night scenes.
